You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (43.8 s) ===
[0.0-2.0] JULIANA (Grief-Stricken): "Do you know they condemned me?"
[2.3-7.8] SCREEN: Tight macro shot on Juliana's chin and throat as she presses a trembling hand against her chest.
[2.3-4.3] JULIANA (Fearful, Pleading): "What if I die here?"

[7.8-12.3] SCREEN: Medium close-up profile of Juliana closing her eyes, drawing a deep breath to steady herself.
[8.3-10.3] JULIANA (Fervent Prayer): "Keep him safe."
[10.6-12.1] JULIANA (Resigned): "Wherever he is."

[12.3-13.8] JULIANA (Determined): "Let him live."
[14.3-17.3] JULIANA (Steely): "And if I have only one thing left to give..."
[17.3-20.8] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Juliana turning toward the cell wall, her blue eyes flashing with fierce loyalty.
[17.6-19.3] JULIANA (Defiant, Unshakable): "I will not give them my husband."
[19.6-21.0] JULIANA (Resolute): "I will not betray him."
[20.8-23.8] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of Juliana's closed eyelids as she takes a sharp, startled breath.
[21.3-23.3] ACTION: Juliana's eyes snap wide open in sudden realization as a deep resonant toll reverberates from above.

[23.8-27.3] SCREEN: Low-angle shot looking up past Juliana kneeling on the wet floor toward the barred iron skylight above her cell.
[25.8-27.1] JULIANA (Startled Whisper): "Bells."
[27.3-29.3] SCREEN: Wide tracking shot as Juliana scrambles to her feet, chains clinking loudly against her skirts.
[27.8-30.3] ACTION: Juliana rushes toward the front of the cell, clutching the iron bars with both hands.
[29.3-35.3] SCREEN: Medium profile shot of Juliana gripping the heavy iron bars, gazing down the corridor toward the source of the sound.
[29.6-31.0] JULIANA (Realizing): "The wedding."
[31.3-32.6] JULIANA (Grim): "It's beginning."
[32.8-35.3] JULIANA (Somber, Steely): "Then I suppose I'm next."
[35.3-41.3] SCREEN: Close-up between the vertical iron bars framed directly on Juliana's face. The terror in her eyes softens into an unexpected, brave smile of enduring faith.
[37.8-40.8] ACTION: Juliana grips the bars tightly, her lips curving into a warm, defiant smile as she whispers her husband's name.
[39.3-40.8] JULIANA (Hopeful, Tender): "Alexander..."
